ei.title: The Fallacy of Composition in Teamwork
ei.subject: 6월_2026 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: The Fallacy of Composition in Teamwork

fullPassage: We can sometimes assume that the whole will be as good as each of its parts. Suppose, for example, you're in charge of a startup, and you know that everyone you've brought on board is productive and efficient. It might seem logical to assume that, as a result, the startup will be productive and efficient, too — but this isn't necessarily true. The fallacy of composition fails to allow for how the different "parts" interact with each other — if, for example, your efficient administrator and your highly skilled head of IT each assumes the other is in charge of collating prototype test results, then you have a problem. Equally, a unit composed of good people can still be working on a doomed project, and a project composed of good ideas may lack a stable center. When assembling a team with a common goal, always check the overall view as well as the individuals involved.

questions.passage: We can sometimes assume that the whole will be as good as each of its parts. Suppose, for example, you're in charge of a startup, and you know that everyone you've brought on board is productive and efficient. It might seem logical to assume that, as a result, the startup will be productive and efficient, too — but this isn't necessarily true. The fallacy of composition fails to allow for how the different "parts" interact with each other — if, for example, your efficient administrator and your highly skilled head of IT each assumes the other is in charge of collating prototype test results, then you have a problem. Equally, a unit composed of good people can still be working on a doomed project, and a project composed of good ideas may lack a stable center. When assembling a team with a common goal, always check the overall view as well as the individuals involved.

det.korean: ④ 'always check the overall view as well as the individuals' = 전체+개인

❌ ② 절대 안 실패: doomed project 가능
❌ ③ 항상 협력: 서로 떠넘기는 예시
✅ ④ 전체+개인: 원문 일치 ← 정답

det.korean: 좋은 아이디어 프로젝트도 안정적 중심(a stable center)이 부족할 수 있다

원문: 'a project composed of good ideas may lack a stable center'
좋은 아이디어로 구성된(composed of good ideas) 프로젝트(project)도 안정적 중심(a stable center)이 부족할 수(may lack) 있다는 문장 전체가 정답
det.tip: may lack a stable center = 안정적 중심이 부족할 수 있다
